motivation: The unscaled estimator on 32 objects lost to the eight-photo mean, while the EEG exchange comparison favored the original assignment. Test whether the regional update overestimates its amplitude.
development: Keep the original 128 training objects. Partition their sorted IDs after permutation with seed 260561 into four object-disjoint folds. Fit the same ridge on the other three folds. Estimate one nonnegative gain, capped at one, by minimizing squared error on all out-of-fold regional deviations from eight supports. Refit the ridge on all 128, freeze its gain before extracting or scoring the additional held-out objects. No hyperparameter sweep.
evaluation: Use all 64 remaining objects of the original 96, excluding every object in the previous regional development result. The evaluation is independent of this regional estimator and its gain; these objects have been used in other historical experiments. Use the original matched, rotated, exchanged and eight-photo mean comparisons, same five disjoint pairs and 10000 object-cluster bootstrap draws with seed 260562. Report each comparison and confirm improvement over both mean and rotation only when both lower confidence bounds exceed zero. If confirmed, test the unchanged spatially masked diffusion design on the previously studied sub-04 personal12 panel with this frozen gain and 128-object ridge.
